## About
Oily's Automotive is a family shop serving Fullerton and the surrounding area. Owner Babington Rice spent many years in the new car industry before opening his own shop, so he could focus on customer service in a way the dealer environment did not allow.
His son Dylan Rice manages the shop and works the front office, ready to help get you back on the road. We pledge to treat you with the honesty and respect we all deserve, and we only do the work you ask for.
One reviewer who moved from Lakewood to Anaheim Hills says he still makes the commute to bring his vehicles to us.

## Services
- Oil change: Oil and filter replacement as part of your regular preventative maintenance.
- Brake service: Brake repair and replacement for domestic and import vehicles.
- Inspections: A courtesy check or full vehicle inspection to catch problems before they turn into costly repairs.
- Check engine light diagnosis: We track down what's behind that light so you know what your car needs.
- Air conditioning service: We'll look at your AC and sort out weak airflow or coolant issues.

## FAQ
Q: Is an appointment necessary?
A: No, an appointment is not necessary. You're also welcome to call ahead and set one up.

Q: Can I get a same-day appointment?
A: One reviewer was able to make a same-day appointment for an oil change. Give us a call to check today's schedule.

Q: Is your work covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. Our work is backed by a 24-month / 24,000-mile warranty.

Q: Who will I see at the front office?
A: Dylan Rice, our manager. You'll catch him in the front office ready to help get you back on the road.
